objective: Review the process-to-launcher CLI fixture implementation and decide whether the chain may move to defining the first runtime execution boundary without treating structured launcher argv materialization as launcher execution, sidecar execution, compare evidence, timing evidence, or direct Verilator sidecar execution.

review_decision.reason: The implementation stays inside the reviewed fixture boundary. The helper is importable, adds no public CLI, requires the current process-to-launcher boundary review gate, rejects predecessor structured-invocation evidence as current authority, rejects generated command text or payload-only authority fields, validates pulp_ita_mha 64x1 scope through the existing reviewed invocation fixture, and emits structured run_hybrid_template.py argv while leaving every launcher, sidecar, compare, timing, and direct-Verilator execution flag false.
review_decision.weakest_point: The strongest remaining risk is over-reading process_to_launcher_cli_bridge_ready and launcher_command_argv as runtime evidence. The accepted implementation proves only that the reviewed process payload can be bound to the exact launcher argv for a later run; it does not start src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py, execute sidecar stages, reach coverage-output compare from direct Verilator sidecar execution, or measure speed.
accepted_because: the primary entrypoint is define_process_to_launcher_cli_fixture and it adds no public CLI
the current process-to-launcher boundary review gate is required before argv materialization
the predecessor structured launcher invocation review gate is retained as reference input but is not accepted as current execution authority
generated command text and parser payload execution-authority fields are rejected before argv materialization
target, template, shape, state count, step count, and launcher argv remain scoped to pulp_ita_mha 64x1
process_to_launcher_cli_bridge_ready is explicitly separated from launcher_cli_invoked and launcher_process_invoked
sidecar stage execution, compare execution, timing, runtime/ABI change, broad RTL/filelist support, and automatic GPU allocation remain false

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_process_to_launcher_cli_execution_boundary_gate
must_define: the narrow first execution boundary after reviewed process-to-launcher CLI argv materialization
which fixture fields may become inputs to an actual launcher process start
which parser payload, sidecar context, source authority, structured invocation reference, and exact launcher argv preconditions are required before src/tools/run_hybrid_template.py may run
how generated execution evidence must stay under reports/ and artifacts/
how coverage_output_equivalence will be checked only after a later reviewed run reaches compare
how launcher_cli_invocation_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, compare_failure, and timing-without-measurement remain distinguishable

process-to-launcher CLI runtime execution by this review gate
